entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I'm calling about my VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I'd like to return it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and the order number?
Sure, the name is Sam Jones, and the order number is VF886753.
Thank you, Sam. I see the order here, delivered on January 3rd. So I can best assist you, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's definitely a preference thing. To be honest, it was a bit of an impulse buy. I've just changed my mind and I've realized I don't use it.
I understand. Thank you for clarifying that.

So, look, I know I've had it for a week. I'm not expecting a full refund necessarily, but would it be possible to get some store credit or maybe a discount on a future purchase? I'm willing to be flexible.
That's very reasonable of you, Sam, but there's no need to negotiate. Let me just pull up our official policy... one moment.
Okay, I've got it here. Since your VeloBand was delivered only 7 days ago, you are well within our 90-day return window for a full refund. I can go ahead and process that for you right now.
Oh, really? 90 days? That's fantastic! I thought it would be much stricter. Yes, please, a full refund would be great.

Absolutely. I've just initiated the return. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label and instructions within the next 15 minutes. Just repackage the VeloBand in its original box and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
That was much easier than I expected. Thank you for your help, Alex.
You're very welcome, Sam. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
